system.description:
You attack with your weapon with knowledge for how they will hinder your targets.

When you would see a hostile creature making a range attack, you attack with your weapon, making a ranged taijutsu attack. On a hit, you select a new valid target for the triggering creatures attack other that the caster themselves. If a jutsu makes a specification in regards to the casters allies or hostile creatures, you ignore that distinction as a part of this jutsu’ s effect.

trigger.text: 1 Reaction, which you take when a creature you can see would make a ranged attack.
